Natural Fluids

Reference Last updated: 2026-11-18

Legacy host. The active Rust/Iced Doppio does not load C++ plugins. These pages document the C++/ImGui plugin SDK and its host in the archived C++ editor (doppio-archived/). The engine still builds every plugin from the submodule so the SDK stays compile-tested.

The Natural Fluids plugin adds animated water and real 2D/3D fluid volumes on top of the engine's fluid simulation.

Natural Fluids is a plugin for the legacy C++/ImGui host for animated water and real fluids. It adds a NaturalFluidComponent to entities and four authoring levels, from a flat water plane to a 3D Eulerian fluid volume.

Four levels#

Level What it does
Flat water A flat animated water plane with a transparent, low-roughness material.
Wind + physics Gerstner wind waves plus a conservative shallow-water solver: wind stress, drops, impulses, terrain bed and volume conservation.
Realistic water A broad Gerstner spectrum with finite-depth dispersion, choppiness, whitecap foam and depth attenuation.
Fluid volume A real 3D Stable-Fluids solver for water, fire, fog and smoke.

How it works#

The engine keeps the simulation, not the plugin:

  • WaveField samples a deterministic Gerstner spectrum from wind, direction, choppiness, wavelength and depth.
  • ShallowWater is a face-staggered shallow-water solver. It conserves volume in a closed basin and reacts to wind, drops and impulses.
  • EulerFluid2D and FluidVolume use semi-Lagrangian advection, Jacobi pressure projection, buoyancy and vorticity confinement. Density and temperature are transported by the incompressible velocity field, so fire rises and smoke/fog drift with the real flow.
  • Scene::tickNaturalFluids rebuilds a smooth water mesh or a density-voxel mesh every frame and feeds the existing scene renderer.

NaturalFluidComponent is a POD and is saved with the scene. Generated meshes are not saved; they are rebuilt on load.

Panel#

In the legacy host, open View → Panels → Natural Fluids (or enable the plugin and use its docked panel). Select an entity with the component, or create one from the panel.

The panel exposes size, water level, wind, amplitude, choppiness, foam threshold, mesh/physics resolution, time scale and material. The fluid volume section adds the material preset (water, fire, fog, smoke), source rate/radius/heat, fluid wind and emission. Buttons inject drops, impulses and puffs and reset the simulation. A live preview draws the water height/foam map, a 2D density slice or two 3D slices.

Rendering#

Water uses the scene PBR shader with a transparent water material. A dedicated water shader with planar refraction/reflection and foam texture is the next step. Fluid volumes are currently visualized as density voxels; a raymarch pass can replace them without changing the solver.

Install#

bash
cmake -S doppio-plugins -B doppio-plugins/build \
  -DCAFFEINE_ROOT="$PWD" \
  -DIMGUI_DIR="$PWD/build/_deps/imgui-src"
cmake --build doppio-plugins/build --target natural_fluids_plugin
cp doppio-plugins/build/plugins/natural_fluids_plugin.so build/plugins/

Enable Natural Fluids in the legacy host's Plugins → Plugin Manager. The component and the engine-side simulation still work in scenes loaded by the Rust Doppio or the runtime; only the plugin panel is missing.
